# YallaCancel (يلا كانسل)

> A free subscription audit tool for Saudi Arabia. Upload your bank statement and instantly discover all hidden recurring charges.

## What it does

YallaCancel analyzes bank statements (CSV and PDF) from all major Saudi banks to find recurring subscriptions. It runs entirely in the browser. No data is uploaded to any server.

## Supported banks

Al Rajhi, Al Ahli (SNB), Riyad Bank, Al Bilad, Al Inma, SABB, Banque Saudi Fransi, Arab National Bank, STC Bank.

## Key features

- Detects 120+ subscription services (Netflix, Spotify, Shahid, Spotify, Adobe, etc.)
- Arabic and English bilingual interface
- Cancel guides for 230+ services with direct cancel links
- Spending breakdown by category
- Privacy-first: all processing happens client-side

## Pages

- Homepage: https://yallacancel.com
- Cancel Guides: https://yallacancel.com/guides
- Individual cancel guides: https://yallacancel.com/cancel-{service-name}.html
